featurebullets: About this item Countertop Microwave Oven with Flatbed Interior: Perfect for reheating various sizes or shapes of dishes, or multiple plates simultaneously without turntable noise or stuttering common in traditional microwaves. Turntable-Free Design: The flat interior without a traditional turntable offers a stable operation and allows for easy cleanup, thanks to the smooth interior surface. Origin Inverter Microwave: Ensures even cooking, precise temperature control, better textures, and enhanced flavor preservation. It operates more quietly while also offers reduced cooking time and energy consumption. 11 Smart Sensor Auto Menus: Pre-programmed sensor menus for optimum heating of standards like pizza, pasta, vegetables and more. The Smart Sensor automatically adjusts power by detecting food moisture. 11 Power Levels: Customize your cooking power levels for culinary flexibility. This essential appliance is perfect for everything from warming up beverages to cooking entrees, side dishes, snacks, and much more. › See more product details
